prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Balz Family Memorabilia, MS 728, Albemarle Charlottesville Historical Society

acqinfo.head: Acquisition Information
acqinfo.p: This small collection of documents (deeds, leases, and St. Anne's School yearbooks) was donated to ACHS by Sarah G. Vicent, daughter of Dorothy and George Adam Balz, in 2024.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: This collection consists of deeds and leases of a property on Main Street Charlottesville.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The collection is boxed with MS 730 and MS 731. It is arranged alphabetically and chronologically.
